title: Pose Reproduction, Cross Docking, Database Enrichment, and Reverse Docking Benchmarks for DOCK6, Vina, and AutoDock 4 with Emphasis on Approved Drugs.
authors: Corbo, Carissa P; Laverty, Scott R; Rizzo, Robert C
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文构建了大规模蛋白-配体复合物基准集SB2025/FARMA2025，并系统评估DOCK6、Vina和AutoDock 4在对接、交叉对接、富集和反向对接中的表现，虽以分子对接为核心且方法为物理模拟，但对象为蛋白-配体复合物而非纯蛋白质结构，且侧重基准测试而非方法创新。
abstract: High-quality test sets to evaluate docking software help the community understand strengths and weaknesses of different methods and programs. In this work, we introduce SB2025, a calculation-ready set of 1,244 protein-ligand complexes derived from the PDB, curated using literature-based ligand protonation states, and freely available in DOCK6, AutoDock Vina, and AutoDock 4 (AD4) formats. SB2025 includes 322 unique proteins, 17 major protein classes, and ligands with a wide range of properties and flexibilities, making it a broad and challenging test set. FARMA2025, a specific subset of SB2025, contains 165 approved drugs bound to their pharmacological targets and closely mirrors the distribution of FDA drug target classes for small molecules through 2023 (r2 = 0.72). Comprehensive benchmarking was subsequently performed to evaluate pose reproduction (PR), cross-docking (CD), database enrichment (DE), and reverse docking (RD) under standardized conditions. Averaged PR success rate across triplicate runs for DOCK6 was slightly improved compared to Vina (followed by AD4) using both the large SB2025 test set and the more drug-focused FARMA2025 test set. Conversely, CD matrix success rates for AD4 were more favorable than DOCK6 or Vina across 11 protein families. The programs all yielded substantial early DE; however, the number of active ligands in common between the programs within the top 1% of the database, with one exception, was surprisingly low. Challenging RD tests using FARMA2025, which gauge the ability to correctly rank the cognate structure best, indicate that generating the correct ligand pose is necessary but not sufficient. SB2025, FARMA2025, and example scripts and protocols for benchmarking are available at ringo.ams.stonybrook.edu (downloads) and github.com/rizzolab.
abstract_zh: 用于评估对接软件的高质量测试集有助于社区理解不同方法和程序的优缺点。在本工作中，我们介绍了SB2025，一个计算就绪的1,244个蛋白质-配体复合物集合，源自PDB，基于文献中的配体质子化状态进行筛选，并以DOCK6、AutoDock Vina和AutoDock 4 (AD4)格式免费提供。SB2025包含322个独特蛋白质、17个主要蛋白质类别，以及具有广泛性质和灵活性的配体，使其成为一个广泛且具有挑战性的测试集。FARMA2025是SB2025的一个特定子集，包含165个与其药理学靶标结合的已批准药物，并紧密反映了截至2023年FDA小分子药物靶标类别的分布（r2 = 0.72）。随后进行了全面基准测试，以在标准化条件下评估姿态重现（pose reproduction, PR）、交叉对接（cross-docking, CD）、数据库富集（database enrichment, DE）和反向对接（reverse docking, RD）。在三次重复运行中，DOCK6的平均PR成功率略优于Vina（其次是AD4），使用大型SB2025测试集和更侧重药物的FARMA2025测试集时均如此。相反，在11个蛋白质家族中，AD4的CD矩阵成功率优于DOCK6或Vina。所有程序在早期DE方面均表现出显著效果；然而，在数据库前1%中，各程序之间共有的活性配体数量，除一个例外，出人意料地低。使用FARMA2025进行的具有挑战性的RD测试，旨在评估正确排名同源结构的能力，表明生成正确的配体姿态是必要的但不足够。SB2025、FARMA2025以及用于基准测试的示例脚本和协议可在ringo.ams.stonybrook.edu（下载）和github.com/rizzolab获取。
